title: 3rd Party Integration
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://dev.dengage.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

This section explains how to connect Dengage with third-party platforms. Each subpage covers one integration with step-by-step setup instructions.

**Navigation:** Settings > Integrations > 3rd Party Integration

## Terms used on this page   [Skip link to Terms used on this page](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration\#terms-used-on-this-page)

- **API User:** a technical user account that an external system uses to send data to Dengage. You create it under Settings > Identity & Access Management > [API Users](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/api-users) and choose which permissions it has.
- **Remote Target:** an external system or platform that Dengage can send data or audiences to. You define it under Settings > Integrations > [Remote Targets](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/remote-targets) by entering the connection credentials.
- **Automated Flow:** a scheduled data job under Data Space > Data Flow > [Automated Flows](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/automated-flow). You use it to export data to a Remote Target on a schedule instead of once.
- **Callback URL:** the Dengage address that a third-party platform sends data to. You copy it from the integration's Details page in Dengage and paste it into the other platform.

## How to connect an integration   [Skip link to How to connect an integration](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration\#how-to-connect-an-integration)

1. Go to Settings > Integrations > 3rd Party Integration.
2. Find the integration and click **Connect**.
3. Follow the steps on the integration's subpage. Some integrations are set up on the third-party side instead; the table below says where.

The integrations shown on your page depend on the features enabled for your account. If an integration you need is not listed or shows a message to contact support, contact your Account Manager or Technical Support.

## Available integrations   [Skip link to Available integrations](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration\#available-integrations)

| Category | Integration | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E-commerce | [Shopify](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/shopify-integration) | One-way sync of your product catalog, contact and order data from your Shopify store to Dengage. You install the app from the Shopify App Store. Works with all Shopify plans, including Shopify Plus. |
| E-commerce | [WooCommerce](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/woo-commerce) | Syncs products, orders, customers and page view, cart and order events from WooCommerce to Dengage. You install the plugin on WordPress 6.0 or above running PHP 7.4 or above. |
| E-commerce | [Magento 2](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/magento-integration) | Syncs contacts, products, product variants, orders, order details and events from Magento to Dengage. Supports Magento 2.2.x, 2.3.x and 2.4.x. |
| E-commerce | [Salesforce Commerce Cloud](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/salesforce) | Syncs contacts, orders, products and events from Salesforce Commerce Cloud to Dengage. Supports Salesforce Storefront Architecture (SFRA). |
| E-commerce | [Bigcommerce](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/bigcommerce-integration) | Syncs products, orders, customers and page view, cart and order events from Bigcommerce to Dengage. Works with all Bigcommerce plans. |
| CRM | [Microsoft Dynamics 365](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/microsoft-dynamics-crm-365) | Syncs Leads, Contacts, Accounts and Opportunities from Dynamics 365 to Dengage. Supports on-premises and cloud versions. You can use Dynamics marketing lists as segment filters. |
| Forms and surveys | [Typeform](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/typeform-integration) | Connects your Typeform account so you can add surveys, map answers to contact fields or tags, embed surveys in on-site and email content, and build segments from survey responses. |
| Forms and surveys | [Typeform Subscription Form](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/typeform-subscription-form) | Uses a Typeform form as a subscription form. Dengage maps the email, phone number and permission fields automatically. Complete the Typeform integration first. |
| Analytics and attribution | [Mixpanel](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/mixpanel) | Syncs a Mixpanel cohort into a Dengage segment over a webhook. The first sync sends the full membership; later syncs send only changes, about every 30 minutes. |
| Analytics and attribution | [Adjust](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/adjust) | Adjust sends mobile app data to Dengage: sessions, uninstalls, reinstalls and mapped events. You add Dengage as a partner in your Adjust account. |
| Advertising | [TikTok](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/tiktok) | Exports Dengage segments as TikTok audiences, once from Data Space > [Exports](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/export) or on a schedule with an Automated Flow. You define TikTok as a Remote Target under Settings > Integrations > Remote Targets. Requires a TikTok Business Account and at least 2,000 contacts in the segment. |
| Messaging | [WhatsApp](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/whatsapp-business-ap%C4%B1) | Connects a WhatsApp Service Provider or the WhatsApp Business API so you can send WhatsApp marketing messages. If you do not see the Connect button, WhatsApp is not yet activated for your account. Contact your Account Manager or Technical Support. |

## Before you start   [Skip link to Before you start](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration\#before-you-start)

Requirements differ by integration. Check the subpage for the exact list. The most common ones are:

- An API User with read and write permissions for Data Space and Transactional Push, created under Settings > Identity & Access Management > API Users. Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Salesforce and Bigcommerce use it.
- Administrator or app installation rights on the third-party side, for example in your Shopify, Bigcommerce, Mixpanel or Adjust account.
- IP addresses added under Settings > Identity & Access Management > [API IP Restriction](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/api-ip-restriction) for integrations that send data from the platform's servers, such as Shopify and Salesforce.
- A business account on the third-party platform where it is required, for example a TikTok Business Account or a WhatsApp Business Account in Meta Business Manager.

## Where each integration is set up   [Skip link to Where each integration is set up](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration\#where-each-integration-is-set-up)

- **From Dengage:** Microsoft Dynamics 365, Adjust, Mixpanel, Typeform and WhatsApp appear on the 3rd Party Integration page. Click **Connect** on the card. After you connect, open **Details** to copy the values you enter on the other side, such as the Callback URL and Access Token.
- **From the e-commerce platform:** For Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Bigcommerce, you install the Dengage app, plugin or cartridge on your store and enter your API User credentials, Region and related settings there.
- **As a Remote Target:** For TikTok, you add TikTok under Settings > Integrations > Remote Targets, then export a segment to it from Data Space > Exports or with an Automated Flow.

## What you can do after connecting   [Skip link to What you can do after connecting](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/3rd-party-integration\#what-you-can-do-after-connecting)

- Sync products, orders and customers from your store to Dengage and use them in segments, personalization and campaign conversion goals.
- Build segments from Typeform survey answers, Mixpanel cohorts or Microsoft Dynamics marketing lists.
- Export segments to TikTok as audiences.
- Send WhatsApp campaigns through your connected provider.
- Receive app session, uninstall and reinstall data from Adjust.
